scripts.gen:api-types: cd server && uv run python export_openapi.py && cd .. && openapi-typescript openapi.json -o src/design/persistence/apiTypes.ts
scripts.api:migrate: cd server && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.api:dev: cd server && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.lint:py: cd server && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.verify:db: cd server && uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run alembic downgrade base && uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run alembic check
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:app && npm test && npm run test:app && npm run lint:py && npm run test:py && npm run verify:db
